item.title: Added · Mission Bay third real-buildings pass: geometrically scanned all 96 sizeable OSM/DataSF building footprints inside the official Mission Bay North/South redevelopment-area boundary against every already-tracked record; found 12 real, in-boundary buildings still uncovered and added them as real footprints (geometry sourced from DataSF Building Footprints, name/address cross-referenced via OpenStreetMap): MB360, Channel Mission Bay, Strata at Mission Bay, J. David Gladstone Institutes, Crescent Cove, Mission Walk (330 and 335 Berry St), Venue, 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard, 1500 and 1700 Owens St, and the Mission Creek Park Pavilion. Two office buildings that scanned as 'uncovered' (China Basin's Wharfside/Berry Buildings at 185 Berry St, and the Bay View Boat Club at 489 Terry Francois Blvd) were investigated and excluded: both sit mostly (88-100%) outside the official redevelopment-area boundary, so they are not in scope even though they touch it. Mission Walk (330 Berry St)'s DataSF footprint originally overlapped the already-committed Arterra building by 712 sq m (caught by check_geometry_quality.py --strict); trimmed to the non-overlapping remainder rather than left overlapping or guessed. The real, notable Edwin M. Lee Apartments (1150 3rd St) was investigated but could not be confidently separated from Venue's footprint in the available data and was left out rather than guessed. Record dossiers deferred to a follow-up pass, matching the UCSF geometry-then-dossiers precedent.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock labeled map: replaced the thin real-street centerline highlight with the real street CORRIDOR (the same curb+centerline buffer join_approximate.py clips against), after the owner flagged Blocks D1/D2/H as appearing to eat the Mission Rock Street sidewalk on sign-off. Measured directly against DataSF's real curb and centerline data: the blocks' south edge (the recorded Assessor lot line) sits ~9.5-10.3m from the street centerline, real curb ~7.2-7.8m -- a genuine ~2.7-3.5m sidewalk gap the blocks already stop short of. No geometry changed; only the map's street rendering, which previously implied a much narrower street than the real right-of-way.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock labeled map, round 2: the round-1 street-corridor fix above unioned in a real DataSF curb LineString that turns out to cover only part of Block H's Mission Rock St frontage, pulling the rendered street edge in tight under part of H (~1.2m gap) while the rest of the D1/D2/H frontage kept the generic ~3.9-4.3m gap -- a false pinch/step the owner flagged as looking wrong ('should be a straight line'). Checked the block geometry first rather than assume it was wrong: D1, D2 and H's south edges are collinear to within millimeters from their own committed coordinates, and the pure centerline buffer (no curb) already runs as one continuous straight band the full frontage length at the same bearing. Added an include_curbs flag to street_geometry.build_street_buffer() (default True, unchanged for every clipping/QA caller) and set it False only for this one map's rendering, so a partial curb segment can't make an already-straight real street look broken on the one map built to show it plainly. No geometry or clipping logic changed.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel A: Port Commission hears an informational report on proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 11, 2026)
